description: This Java class provides a method to supply an instance identifier based on environment variables or hostname, primarily used in containerized environments for service identification.

classes.name: InstanceIdentifierSupplier
classes.description: A singleton class that supplies an instance identifier based on environment variables or hostname.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of InstanceIdentifierSupplier.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the instance identifier, caching it after the first retrieval.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the instance identifier from the environment variable or hostname supplier.
